About this design preview

The layout and all 283 faces come from your SketchUp model (krisnagiri living area.skp), including the colours you painted on the back side of faces. Every unit is built from what you confirmed on 22 November 2026.

Wooden mica (your reference, same as the kitchen) on the frames, posts, rafters, wall-unit top, TV shutters, staircase storage and the open display boxes. Wood-slat louver panels above the TV wall and above the book-shelf unit. White marble-look TV background (from your photo; the brown panels in that photo are not used). TV base shutters and the wall-unit shutters beside the seat in classy beige (as the pooja shutters). Crockery unit with tinted glass shutters, book shelf and TV display box with clear glass, grey tinted glass display at the entrance; all with concealed lights. Pooja shutters: CNC design from your photo in classy beige. Concealed LED strips, small surface lights over the rafters, pencil lights over the money plants and bonsai, and plant shelves between the rafters at 5 ft and 4 ft.

Still approximate: glass shades, number of shelves, hinge sides, cushion colour and the plants. Use Lighting on/off to compare. Reference colours shows your original SketchUp colours.
